newsitem.title: USA: U of Michigan consumer sentiment Oct final 96.5.
newsitem.headline: U of Michigan consumer sentiment Oct final 96.5.

text.p: The University of Michigan's final index of consumer sentiment for October rose to 96.5 compared to 94.7 in the final September index, financial market sources said on Friday.
The current conditions component rose to 106.6 in the October final report against the 102.0 reading in the final September.
The expectations index fell to 89.9 in the final October data versus the 90.1 in the final September, the sources added. The data are released only to paying subscribers.
